SELECT fnd09_trust_bank_id AS trust_bank_id, fnd09_trust_bank_cd AS trust_bank_code, fnd09_trust_bank_nm AS trust_bank_name, fnd09_use_yn AS use_yn, fnd09_note AS note, fnd09_company_id AS company_id FROM fnd09_trust_bank WHERE fnd09_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(fnd09_trust_bank_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
